description: MEASURE a take instead of guessing: give the audio (a render_midi take URL, any recording) and the notes it should play — notes[] + bpm (and tempo_map) or a midi_url — and get back how many written notes were heard at the right pitch and time (recall / precision / f1, octave errors, the first missed notes with their beats), the timing error in ms, loudness (integrated LUFS, peak dBFS, clipped share), any stretch where a note was written but nothing sounds, and a verdict (good / check / bad) with reasons in plain words. doseedo_render_midi results already carry this per take (takes[].check) when the part was given as notes. Method: an independent note transcriber (basic-pitch) — dense chords and very fast runs read less reliably; use it as a screen, and listen to anything marked check. Synchronous (~3–15 s), CPU, no credits. Cancel: not applicable — the result is returned in the submit response; the job is already finished.

audio_key.description: R2 ingest key of an uploaded audio file (from doseedo_get_upload_url / POST /api/upload/r2/ingest-url; starts with "ingest/"). Alternative to audio_url.

audio_url.description: The take: a doseedo result URL as returned, or any public https URL.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

instrument.description: The instrument (a drum/percussion name switches to onset-only matching).

midi_url.description: Alternative to notes: the part as a Standard MIDI File (≤ 2 MiB).

notes.description: The notes the take should play, in beats from bar 1 (the rows you sent doseedo_render_midi).

onset_tolerance_ms.description: How far a heard onset may be from the written one and still count (default 50).

name: doseedo_check_take
title: Check a take against its notes
